title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, or Python; knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
description: Google Software Engineering Interns work on core products and real-world infrastructure alongside full-time engineers, designing efficient systems and tools.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: 1+ years of practical experience with JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and React or Vue.js.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
description: Collaborate asynchronously across global teams to build user-friendly interfaces and optimize open-source web application modules.

title: Chevening UK Government Scholarship 2025
eligibility: International students with an undergraduate degree and at least 2 years of work experience.
qualification: Undergraduate degree, English language proficiency, strong leadership qualities.
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue a one-year master's degree in any subject at any UK university.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or candidates with less than 2 years of product management experience.
qualification: Degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
description: Drive product features from conception to release, work with cross-functional technical teams, and analyze user feedback to optimize customer impact.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university globally.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD prize + Azure credits
qualification: Student status; teams of 1 to 4 members.
description: Global technology competition encouraging students to build cutting-edge solutions using AI and cloud tech to address major social and industrial challenges.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to learners of all backgrounds worldwide.
qualification: No prior programming or computer science experience required.
description: An entry-level course teaching how to think algorithmically and solve technical problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
